credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.role_title: Working Student (f/m/d) Generative AI & Software Modernization
letter.opening: I am applying for the Working Student position in Generative AI & Software Modernization. Building and evaluating LLM-based solutions, with automated tests and clear documentation, is what my latest project is about.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence and C1 English (IELTS 8.0).

achievements.impact: I built a RAG application with the Claude API, evaluated on a 22-question test set: 91% correct, all 4 unanswerable questions refused, and hybrid retrieval raised MRR from 0.748 to 0.898
DocuMind has 37 offline unit tests with a mocked LLM client, GitHub Actions CI and Docker
I fine-tuned a pretrained EfficientNet-B0 in PyTorch to 94.11% accuracy on a 968-image test set

letter.problems_section: I would support senior developers in building and evaluating generative AI solutions for code analysis and refactoring, write tests and document results. I have not used LLMs for code analysis yet and my C-family experience is limited, so I would build these skills in your team.
letter.closing: I am willing to relocate to Munich and can work up to 20 hours per week, starting immediately. I would be glad to discuss the role.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
